title: Rabbi Tachlifa, Father-in-Law of Rabbi Acha
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot, chapter 1, halakhah 1, he and Rabbi Acha both speak in the name of Rabbi Shmuel bar Nachman. Hyman attributes the identification with Rav Tachlifa of the West to Mavo HaYerushalmi.

notes.text: The supplied locator is ברכות פ״א ה״א-ו. The Guggenheimer digital text of Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 1:1 confirms Acha and Tachlifa, his father-in-law, reporting Shmuel bar Nachman. The suffix ו remains unexplained; it is not asserted to mean folio 6, and no unsupported Venice pagination is supplied.

In the Guggenheimer digital edition, the passage naming Acha and his father-in-law Tachlifa comes after a Vilna 6a page marker within Berakhot 1:1. That placement leaves the exact convention behind Hyman’s suffix ו open. Hyman prints the identification with Rav Tachlifa of the West as the view of Mavo HaYerushalmi. The cited passage in that work has yet to be independently verified.
